name: GDELT Project
summary: Free search over worldwide online news monitored by GDELT: article lists and coverage-volume, tone, language and source-country timelines.
notes: Keyless and free. The service asks for at most one request every 5 seconds and answers 429 otherwise.
The DOC API searches the last 3 months of coverage by default.
The GEO 2.0 API at /geo/geo answered 404 when this entry was written, so it is left out.
Output defaults to HTML: pass format=json for data.
All operators go inside the query parameter.

endpoints.name: Search news articles
endpoints.summary: Matching news articles (URL, title, date, domain, language, source country, image) from GDELT's monitored coverage.

query.description: Keywords and "quoted phrases", (a OR b) blocks (not nested), -term to exclude, and operators domain:, domainis:, sourcecountry:, sourcelang:, theme:, tone>N / tone<N, near:, repeat:.

format.description: Output format; default HTML. Use json (or csv).

timespan.description: Window back from now: number plus min, h, d, w or m (minimum 15 minutes), e.g. 1w.

startdatetime.description: Start, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, within the last 3 months.

enddatetime.description: End, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, within the last 3 months.

mode.description: artlist for a list of articles; artgallery for a visual list.

sort.description: hybridrel (default relevance), datedesc, dateasc, tonedesc, toneasc.
